interpretation: Review candidates only. Not an AI detector or quality score.

issues.label: Cluster of conventional AI-associated terms
issues.rationale: Check whether repeated ornamental wording improves precision.
issues.false_positive_guard: These words are never authorship evidence and may be entirely appropriate.

issues.label: Generic significance framing
issues.rationale: The claim may lack a study-specific reason for importance.
issues.false_positive_guard: General context can be appropriate in interdisciplinary introductions.

issues.label: Non-substantive metacommentary
issues.excerpt: It is important to note that
issues.rationale: The clause announces rather than conveys scientific content.
issues.false_positive_guard: Long technical documents may require a clear section roadmap.

issues.label: Unspecified critique of prior work
issues.rationale: The comparison may need specific evidence and citations.
issues.false_positive_guard: A nearby citation or established literature summary may support it.

issues.label: Evaluative result instead of observation
issues.rationale: The sentence may emphasize significance rather than reported findings.
issues.false_positive_guard: Qualitative research may report themes rather than numbers.

issues.label: Decorative general recap
issues.excerpt: These findings underscore the importance of
issues.rationale: Consider ending with the concrete finding rather than generalized importance.
issues.false_positive_guard: A conclusion is appropriate when it answers the specific question.

issues.label: Generic future-work sentence
issues.rationale: The sentence does not identify the unresolved research question.
issues.false_positive_guard: Some journal conclusions require a concise future-work statement.
